name: Alaska Permanent Fund Dividend: micro vs macro employment effects (Jones & Marinescu 2022)
description: The authors' own back-of-envelope calibration (AEJ:EP 2022, Section V.C, Table 5): a negative income effect on the employment rate from the lifetime value of the dividend, offset by a positive labour-demand effect from dividend spending. Default parameters are the published (AEJ) edition; the overlay alaska-pfd-wp2020 restores the working-paper edition. Used by the policy-effect case data/cases/alaska-pfd.json.
scope: Alaska, 1982-2014 average, employment-to-population ratio (age 16+), extensive margin only. One static calculation per year, constant over the period because the authors use period averages. No part-time margin, no hours, no sectors, no migration, no taxes. It reproduces the authors' calibration; it is not an independent structural model and it is not fitted to their synthetic-control estimate.
license: Numbers quoted from a published article for research use; see docs/design/research/alaska-pfd-case.md
